description: The plot titled “Massive Activation of baseline” shows maximum activation values across model layers for four series labeled in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 23 with major ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” on a linear scale from 0 up to 1600, with regularly spaced tick marks every 200 units. The blue dashed line with small circular markers (“attn_output”) stays near 0 from early layers through about layer 21, then rises sharply at the end, reaching roughly 250 by the final layer. The orange dotted line (“attn_residual”) is near 0 through about layer 4–5, then jumps to around 1400 near layer 6, increases to about 1500 by roughly layers 13–14, remains near a high plateau around 1550–1600 through about layer 21, and then drops steeply near the last layers to roughly 250 at the endpoint. The green dash-dot line (“ffn_output”) is near 0 in the earliest layers, exhibits a sharp spike near layer 5 to about 1350, quickly falls back toward near-0 values by around layers 7–10, shows another pronounced peak around layer 13 near roughly 650 before dropping again to low tens/near-0 by around layers 15–20, and then rises steeply again around layer 22 to roughly 1150 before ending lower near about 600 at the final layer. The red solid line (“ffn_residual”) is near 0 through about layer 4–5, jumps to approximately 1400 near layer 5, climbs to around 1480 by about layer 7, stays near that level through roughly layer 12, increases to a higher plateau near about 1580 around layers 14–15, remains near that plateau through about layer 21, and then drops sharply near layer 22 to roughly 400 before ending around 600 at the final layer.
